This plot is small, only 0.08 hectares, so I cannot spend too much on it. Last season I got some fertilizer through the FISP coupon, and I am hoping to get it again this year — if I do, I will put one bag of NPK at planting and one bag of urea for topdressing, which is what the agro-dealer tells us to do for maize. I will buy hybrid seed because with fertilizer the local seed does not pay back as well, and my neighbor who used hybrid last year harvested more bags than me. I intercrop with pigeon pea or beans like most people here, I put manure from the few goats we keep, and I do not have money for pesticides or a pump for irrigation — I weed by hand with my wife and my young brother helping.
